description:
Mirror the file transaction kernel rollback-stage cleanup failure point in the in-memory conformance backend so shared crash coverage observes the same prepared-recovery boundary.

## Background

JSON prepared recovery invokes `RepositoryBeforeStageCleanup` after all reverse actions and before the rollback decision. Memory prepared recovery currently jumps directly from reverse-action checks to `RepositoryBeforeRollbackDecision`; its existing stage-cleanup hook belongs only to normal committed apply. This is a conformance observability gap, not a transaction or journal semantic change.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: In-memory prepared recovery invokes `RepositoryBeforeStageCleanup` after the final reverse-action hook and before `RepositoryBeforeRollbackDecision` for both existing-root and absent-root recovery.
- [hard] REQ-02: A failure injected at the stage-cleanup edge retains prepared residue so a later clean session retries and converges to the original state.
- [hard] REQ-03: Focused tests prove hook order and retry behavior while committed recovery and transaction semantics remain unchanged.
title: Mirror prepared rollback stage-cleanup edge in memory recovery
